notes.title: VERSION 2.0 of the Game coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34386777/01799aaf5691bbdebf53db872358f026062c0e68.png[/img]

[h2]The big update of the game version 2.0 is coming very soon![/h2] 

[b]The game is going to have its first big update, here are the major changes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] The past chapters will no longer be available, new chapters will be added, and the story that people know of the game,  later will match the version 2 of the game!

[b][*] New origin chapters! more story to discover!  The game is more like an interactive visual novel, so be ready to enjoy more rich story and adult content[/b]

[*] Keep in mind that this is the very first update of the version 2 of the game, it does not mean, is a full 2nd version of the game, is just the beginning of the new version

[b][*] The game is still under constant development and improvement[/b]

[*]The controls change a little so be sure to check them out in game
[/olist]
[h2] The player will start as Lioba ice sorceress and cousin of the Dark King Thormentor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34386777/bb8a9e0683173f32968f470e4186122860915b1e.jpg[/img]

I know that many of you want to play with all the different classes and characters, but bear with me a little, the story will give you a lot of fan service now ;)

[b]Later in game, you will have the option to fight battles as regular Dark elf soldiers, Elf soldiers, Templars and Teutonic knights[/b]

All heroes when they die is game over, but regular soldiers can re spawn! until you get victory!

[b]That's pretty much all for now! See you soon for the big first update Templars![/b]

Thank you everyone for your support and for taking your time to know that this game is still under development!

notes.title: UPDATE READY to play!!
notes.notes:
The Update is ready to play!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xUwIQnD.jpg[/img]

Now the game is only for Windows 64 bits, and requires more power from your PC, check the minimum requirements! 

Here are some new key features!

1.-Angelore no longer dies and is game over, Angelore gets knockout, and can get up with health potions or food, some times requires 2 health potions. 

2.-New Character Camila, will give you Health Potions and Stamina potions! so go find her as soon as you can!

3.-You play as the Dark King Thormentor in the final Boss fight, Thormentor can not get up from knock out, if you fall is game over. Press 1 and 2 for Thormentor best attack moves!

4.-If you get stuck, press 4, to jump out of stuck.

5.-Enemies are stronger, use left SHIFT to use your shield, and also some enemies are incredibly strong, jump out with Q or 4 when enemy got you cornered.

6.-Now you can hide or show the mouse by pressing Esc. Show the mouse to click on the Scroll in the top of the screen and see the map, or go back to the main menu and exit game. Also show/hide the mouse to interact with your inventory.

7.-Battle Score added, from the begining to the end of Chapter 1 you can make over 100 points, take a screenshot if you make over 100 points and upload it to Steam, to participate to win a prize from the developer.

Thank you all for your feedback and support! ːsteamhappyː

Carlos M Martinez
Developer
Angel Light The elven Truce
R-R  studios

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oy5xPVp.png[/img]

Hello gamers! The Update I have been working on, is almost ready!

The gameplay will change a little in the next aspects:

1.-Player no longer dies and is game over. Now Angelore can get up from knockout if you still have Health potions in your inventory or food.

Final Battle is the only exception where you can not get up from knockout

2.-Enemies hit harder than before. Use your shield!

3.-Angelore Run speed has being increased by a lot, so you can move fast in areas that you need to, or for easy scape Orc attacks.

4.-Thormentor and his cousin Lioba, now help you in the first part of the game.

5.-The Templar Knights Hector and Sigrun help Angelore in the second part of the game and they do more damage.

6.-Verion and Orcs as final Boss remain as only player can defeat, in the last boss battle, they have less Health to make it easier.

7.-Battle Score added, Now every kill increases your Battle Score. There are going to be prizes for those who upload a screenshot of their Battle Score above 100.

I hope that all of you like the new update and have lots of fun! Expect more surprises as well! ːsteamhappyː

Carlos M. Martinez
Developer
Angel Light The Elven Truce
Rocket Regios studios
